The company's distribution center is located in the city center, and each vehicle can carry up to 80 medical supply units. """
vehicle_routing_problem_with_time_window_003 - OR-Tools VRPTW
Fixes: remove ReadAssignmentFromRoutes(initial_routes) and hardcoded total_time=737.
40 hospitals, 7 vehicles.
"""
import math, json
from ortools.constraint_solver import routing_enums_pb2, pywrapcp

def solve():
    customers_data = [
        [15.0,0.0,8,30,91,12],[14.9,8.2,13,45,120,14],[10.3,16.0,12,60,128,14],
        [1.5,20.9,8,75,178,12],[-9.6,20.9,7,90,187,12],[-20.0,15.0,18,105,167,16],
        [-26.7,3.8,5,120,185,11],[-27.2,-10.2,11,135,209,13],[-20.3,-23.5,5,150,245,11],
        [-7.0,-32.3,11,165,270,15],[7.0,-32.3,10,180,285,14],[20.3,-23.5,12,195,300,16],
        [27.2,-10.2,9,210,315,13],[26.7,3.8,13,225,330,15],[20.0,15.0,7,240,345,12],
        [15.6,42.2,18,255,360,16],[-15.6,42.2,6,270,375,11],[-26.7,26.7,14,285,390,15],
        [-32.3,7.0,8,300,405,12],[-32.3,-7.0,12,315,420,14],[-26.7,-26.7,10,330,435,13],
        [-15.6,-42.2,15,345,450,15],[0.0,-48.0,9,360,465,13],[15.6,-42.2,11,375,480,14],
        [26.7,-26.7,7,390,495,12],[32.3,-7.0,13,405,510,15],[32.3,7.0,8,420,525,12],
        [26.7,26.7,16,435,540,16],[15.6,42.2,5,450,555,11],[0.0,48.0,10,465,570,13],
        [-15.6,42.2,12,480,585,14],[-26.7,26.7,9,495,600,13],[-32.3,7.0,14,510,615,15],
        [-32.3,-7.0,6,525,630,11],[-26.7,-26.7,11,540,645,14],[-15.6,-42.2,8,555,660,12],
        [0.0,-48.0,13,570,675,15],[15.6,-42.2,7,585,690,12],[26.7,-26.7,10,600,705,13],
        [32.3,-7.0,9,615,720,13]
    ]
    locations = [[0.0,0.0]] + [[c[0],c[1]] for c in customers_data]
    demands = [0] + [int(c[2]) for c in customers_data]
    time_windows = [(0,740)] + [(int(c[3]),int(c[4])) for c in customers_data]
    service_time = [0] + [int(c[5]) for c in customers_data]
    num_vehicles = 7
    vehicle_capacity = 80
    speed_per_min = 35.0 / 60.0
    depot = 0
    max_horizon = 740

    dm = [[math.hypot(locations[i][0]-locations[j][0], locations[i][1]-locations[j][1])
           for j in range(len(locations))] for i in range(len(locations))]

    manager = pywrapcp.RoutingIndexManager(len(locations), num_vehicles, depot)
    routing = pywrapcp.RoutingModel(manager)

    SCALE = 1000
    def dist_cb(f, t):
        return int(dm[manager.IndexToNode(f)][manager.IndexToNode(t)] * SCALE)
    di = routing.RegisterTransitCallback(dist_cb)
    routing.SetArcCostEvaluatorOfAllVehicles(di)

    TIME_SCALE = 10
    def time_cb(f, t):
        fn, tn = manager.IndexToNode(f), manager.IndexToNode(t)
        return int((dm[fn][tn] / speed_per_min + service_time[fn]) * TIME_SCALE)
    ti = routing.RegisterTransitCallback(time_cb)

    def demand_cb(f): return demands[manager.IndexToNode(f)]
    dci = routing.RegisterUnaryTransitCallback(demand_cb)
    routing.AddDimensionWithVehicleCapacity(dci, 0, [vehicle_capacity]*num_vehicles, True, 'Cap')

    routing.AddDimension(ti, int(max_horizon*TIME_SCALE), int(max_horizon*TIME_SCALE), False, 'Time')
    time_dim = routing.GetDimensionOrDie('Time')
    for i, (lo, hi) in enumerate(time_windows):
        if i == depot: continue
        time_dim.CumulVar(manager.NodeToIndex(i)).SetRange(int(lo*TIME_SCALE), int(hi*TIME_SCALE))

    params = pywrapcp.DefaultRoutingSearchParameters()
    params.first_solution_strategy = routing_enums_pb2.FirstSolutionStrategy.PATH_CHEAPEST_ARC
    params.local_search_metaheuristic = routing_enums_pb2.LocalSearchMetaheuristic.GUIDED_LOCAL_SEARCH
    params.time_limit.seconds = 120

    sol = routing.SolveWithParameters(params)
    if not sol:
        print(json.dumps({"error": "no solution"})); return

    routes = []; total_dist = 0.0; max_time = 0.0; vehicle_loads = []
    for v in range(num_vehicles):
        idx = routing.Start(v)
        route = []
        while not routing.IsEnd(idx):
            route.append(manager.IndexToNode(idx))
            idx = sol.Value(routing.NextVar(idx))
        route.append(depot); routes.append(route)

        cur_t = 0.0; dist = 0.0; load = 0
        for k in range(len(route)-1):
            u, nv = route[k], route[k+1]
            d = dm[u][nv]; dist += d
            cur_t += d / speed_per_min
            if nv != depot:
                cur_t = max(cur_t, float(time_windows[nv][0]))
                cur_t += service_time[nv]
                load += demands[nv]
        total_dist += dist; vehicle_loads.append(load)
        if load > 0 and cur_t > max_time: max_time = cur_t

    print(json.dumps({
        "routes": routes,
        "total_time": round(max_time),
        "total_distance": round(total_dist, 3),
        "van_loads": vehicle_loads
    }))

if __name__ == '__main__': solve()
